subject: general
question: Following the provisions of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment 1992, how frequently are the members of the Gram Sabha expected to meet in a year?

options.text: At least twice in a year

solution:
The correct answer is __**At least twice in a year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• According to the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, the **Gram Sabha** is the cornerstone of the Panchayati Raj system in India.
 
• As per its provisions, the members of the Gram Sabha are required to meet **at least twice every year**.
